title: Local descent of raw higher-direct-image cohomology-presheaf classes
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], I a nonempty directed preorder, and D an inverse system over S with affine transitions and qcqs structure maps. Let c be a cone whose underlying scheme cone is limiting and whose structure map is qcqs. Let F_i be compatible abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] with unital and composable inverse-image transition maps [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let H present their pullbacks to the limit and set F = colim H. Fix p >= 0. Let K present the stage higher direct images with transition maps given by [def-sbc-abelian-higher-direct-image-map], and let eta be their canonical cocone into T = R^p g_* F [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Define P(U) = Hom(g^* Z[U][0], F[0][p]), where Z[U] is the sheafified free abelian representable [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] and Hom is in the bounded-below derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. There exists an isomorphism e from P^# to T such that, for every etale U and z in P(U), there is a covering sieve R on U for which every arrow f: V to U in R admits an index i and a section y in K_i(V) with eta_i(y) equal to the restriction along f of the image of z under the sheafification unit followed by e. The data H, K and eta satisfy the explicit canonical transition and component equations in the Lean signature.

source.place: Lemma 59.51.7 proof, affine-etale cohomology comparison; Tag 03Q8 supplies the natural sheafification comparison

proof.text: Choose the natural higher-direct-image sheafification comparison e of Tag 03Q8. Free abelian sheaves corepresent sections and derived adjunction identifies P(U) with degree-p cohomology on U times_S X. Use the natural comparison produced by this argument; compatibility is not claimed for an arbitrary abstract sheafification isomorphism.

Cover the etale U by affine etale V. Base change the inverse system to V. Its stages are qcqs by the qcqs structure-map hypotheses and affineness of V, transitions are affine by base change, and the base-changed cone is limiting. Pull back F_i and their transition maps. Inverse image preserves colimits, identifying the restricted limit sheaf with their colimit. Place the sheaves in degree zero. Apply complex cohomology continuity and the filtered-colimit representative property to the restriction of z to produce a stage cohomology class.

Send each stage class through the cohomology-presheaf comparison and through (eK i).inv to obtain y in K_i(V). The comparison is natural: the presheaf class map pulls back the representing derived morphism and composes with the coefficient map F_i to F. Applying homology to the derived adjunction unit, composition comparison, counit and coefficient map gives exactly abelianHigherDirectImageMap. The equation hK identifies the stage transition diagram with these same maps. Thus hη identifies η_i(y) with the restriction of the image of z under toSheafify followed by e.hom.

Generate a sieve R from the affine covering arrows. It covers U. Any arrow in R factors through a generator; restrict its chosen stage section along the factor. Naturality of η and of restrictions preserves the lifting equation, proving the assertion on every arrow of R.

proof_origin.place: Affine-etale cohomology continuity part of Lemma 59.51.7; naturality of the derived-Hom presentation from Tag 03Q8 spelled out

theorem exists_higherDirectImage_limit_presheaf_class_cover {S : Scheme.{v}}
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Over S)
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f).left]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiCompact (D.obj i).hom]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparated (D.obj i).hom]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget S).mapCone c))
    [QuasiCompact c.pt.hom] [QuasiSeparated c.pt.hom]
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (((D.map f.op).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hφid : ∀ i : I, HEq (φ (𝟙 i))
      ((upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.obj (op i)).left).hom.app (F i)))
    (hφcomp : ∀ {i j k : I} (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k), HEq (φ (f ≫ g))
      ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.map g.op).left
          (D.map f.op).left).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (((D.map g.op).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).map (φ f) ≫ φ g))
    (H : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (eH : ∀ i : I, H.obj i ≅
      (((c.π.app (op i)).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj (F i))
    (hH : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), H.map f =
      (eH i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (c.π.app (op j)).left (D.map f.op).left
          (c.π.app (op i)).left
          (congrArg (fun t => t.left) (c.w f.op)).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (((c.π.app (op j)).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).map (φ f) ≫ (eH j).inv)
    [HasColimit H] (p : ℕ)
    (K : I ⥤ Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (eK : ∀ i : I, K.obj i ≅
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ (p : ℤ)).obj
        (R+(((D.obj (op i)).hom)_*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (F i))))
    (hK : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), K.map f =
      (eK i).hom ≫ abelianHigherDirectImageMap (D.map f.op).left
        (D.obj (op i)).hom (D.obj (op j)).hom (Over.w (D.map f.op)) p
        (F i) (F j) (φ f) ≫ (eK j).inv)
    (η : K ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ (p : ℤ)).obj
        (R+((c.pt.hom)_*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (colimit H)))))
    (hη : ∀ i : I, η.app i = (eK i).hom ≫
      abelianHigherDirectImageMap (c.π.app (op i)).left (D.obj (op i)).hom c.pt.hom
        (Over.w (c.π.app (op i))) p (F i) (colimit H)
        ((eH i).inv ≫ colimit.ι H i)) :
    let T := (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ (p : ℤ)).obj
      (R+((c.pt.hom)_*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (colimit H)))
    let P := (uliftYoneda.{v + 1} ⋙
      (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj AddCommGrpCat.free ⋙
      presheafToSheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} ⋙
      upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} c.pt.hom ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).op ⋙
        preadditiveYoneda.obj
          (((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (colimit H))⟦(p : ℤ)⟧)
    ∃ (e : (presheafToSheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).obj P ≅ T),
      ∀ (U : S.Etale) (z : P.obj (op U)),
        ∃ (R : Sieve U), R ∈ S.smallEtaleTopology U ∧
          ∀ {V : S.Etale} (f : V ⟶ U), R f →
            ∃ (i : I) (y : (K.obj i).obj.obj (op V)),
              (η.app i).hom.app (op V) y =
                T.obj.map f.op
                  ((toSheafify S.smallEtaleTopology P ≫ e.hom.hom).app (op U) z)
